sources.claim: Unit 42 reports Royal as a private group made up of former Conti members.
Trend Micro reports Royal as backed by actors from Conti.

curator_note: Operator continuity only. This edge does not assert Royal code lineage from Conti.
confidence_reason: Two vendor sources make direct former-Conti or Conti-backed operator claims, but neither is used here as malware-family derivation evidence.
